# TwitterTools

> Free, open-source toolkit for X (Twitter). Ten tools, no login, no tracking.
> Site: https://twittertools.com · Source: https://github.com/steley/twittertools

## Tools (browser-based, no account)

- [Video Downloader](https://twittertools.com/twitter-video-downloader/) — save videos & GIFs as MP4
- [Image Downloader](https://twittertools.com/twitter-image-downloader/) — original-resolution photos
- [Thread Reader](https://twittertools.com/twitter-thread-reader/) — unroll threads, export Markdown/TXT/HTML/PDF
- [Advanced Search Builder](https://twittertools.com/twitter-advanced-search-builder/) — GUI for X search operators
- [Tweet Splitter](https://twittertools.com/tweet-splitter/) — split long text into a numbered thread
- [Character Counter](https://twittertools.com/tweet-character-counter/) — X's real weighted counting (CJK ×2, links = 23)
- [Font Generator](https://twittertools.com/twitter-font-generator/) — Unicode styles for posts and bios
- [Screenshot Generator](https://twittertools.com/tweet-screenshot-generator/) — polished PNG cards of any post
- [URL & ID Parser](https://twittertools.com/tweet-url-parser/) — post URLs ↔ IDs ↔ Snowflake timestamps
- [Bookmark Manager](https://twittertools.com/bookmark-manager/) — local-first bookmark library (PWA)

## Public API (stateless, no keys, rate-limited per IP)

- `GET https://twittertools.com/api/tweet?id={url-or-id}` → `{tweet}` — text, author, media with direct CDN URLs
- `GET https://twittertools.com/api/thread?url={url-or-id}` → `{tweets, partial, reason?}` — thread unroll (paste the LAST post for the full chain)
- `GET https://twittertools.com/api/download?url={pbs/video.twimg.com-url}&name={filename}` → proxied media stream

## MCP server for AI agents

- `npx twittertools-mcp` — stdio MCP server exposing `get_tweet`, `get_thread`,
  `count_chars`, `split_thread`, `parse_tweet_url`
- Docs: https://github.com/steley/twittertools/tree/main/mcp
